ValidationRule.description: Requires Loss Reason when Opp is Lost (Stage 9-Lost or Forecast Status = Lost), including at creation. Closes the insert/Forecast-Status gap left by Opp_Gate_9_Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(Loss_Reason__c)), OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "9-Lost"), ISPICKVAL(Forecast_Status__c, "Lost")), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISCHANGED(Forecast_Status__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Loss Reason is required when the opportunity is Lost (Stage 9-Lost or Forecast Status = Lost).
